claims.statement: A union-closed family containing {a} has a in at least half of its members.
A union-closed family containing {a,b} has at least one of a or b in at least half of its members.
Exact independent replay finds no nontrivial violation on universes n <= 4.
Every finite nontrivial union-closed family is Frankl-abundant.

prohibited_promotion: Restricted Lean theorems do not imply Frankl's conjecture.
